narrative: 黑色头发、黑色服装、黑色布景：没有发丝光（Hair Light），整个头部会变成一个洞。这个灯具是一种分离工具，而不是美颜光洗。
影棚人像和经典特写使用它，让发髻、波浪卷发或湿漉漉的头皮有一道高光边缘。当故事重点是一顶不想被打油光的帽檐或光头，或者一整道逆光应该同时包裹肩膀时，它就不是合适的工具。
如果这盏灯降到脸颊高度，它就变成了侧逆光（Kicker）。
how: 把一盏小灯架在高处和后方，与主光大致相对，用蜂窝罩或挡光条限制光斑，让它只打在头发上，也许再加上肩膀顶部。硬度通常比主光更硬，让发丝闪亮。
颜色常常比脸部略暖，或与主光一致。避免让光照进眼睛。
提示词：A small lamp behind and above [Subject], lighting only the top of the hair as a rim. The face stays in cooler shadow.
when: 当深色头发会消失在暗墙中时使用，比如一个身处暗色室内的深发女子。不要把它用成一道扫过额头和鼻子的天花板光洗。
vs: 逆光（Backlight）可以包括头发，也包括肩膀和光雾。轮廓光（Rim Light）沿着整个轮廓运行。
侧逆光亲吻的是下颌，而不是头顶。三点布光（Three-Point Lighting）常常把发丝光用作它的逆光点。
魅力光（Glam）可能包括一道发丝光边，但魅力光是一整套正面美颜方案。
examples_film: 影棚人像和经典特写——包括《绅士爱美人》（Gentlemen Prefer Blondes）中的金发与深发造型，以及《迷魂记》（Vertigo）中刻意打造的发丝光边——都在头发上保留一盏小小的后方顶部灯具。脸依然属于主光。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是一整道逆光，或一圈光环。破绽是头部周围出现一圈发光的椭圆形，或者额头从上方泛出油光。
解决办法是用蜂窝罩把这盏灯限制在头发上，让脸保持在主光的范围内。

faq.q: 电影中的发丝光是什么？
faq.a: 一盏位于主体后方和上方的小灯，照亮头发的质感，形成轮廓光边。它把深色头发从暗色背景中分离出来，而不会重新照亮整张脸。

faq.q: 发丝光和逆光有什么区别？
faq.a: 发丝光是一种限定在头顶的逆光。逆光可能包裹整个后方轮廓，包括肩膀和空气中的光雾。
当黑色或深色头发会与布景融为一体时使用。帽子、想保持哑光的光头，或者整道后方轮廓光才是重点时，就不要用它。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示发丝光？
faq.a: 在后方和上方放一盏小灯，只照亮头发顶部。让脸保持在主光下，或处于偏冷的阴影中。

narrative: Black hair, black wardrobe, black set: without a hair light the head becomes a hole. The unit is a separation tool, not a beauty wash.

Studio portraits and classical close-ups use it so a bun, a wave, or a wet scalp has a specular edge. It is the wrong tool when the story is a hat brim or a bald scalp you do not want to grease, or when a full backlight should wrap shoulders as well.
If the lamp drops to cheek height it becomes a kicker.
how: Mount a small lamp high and behind, slightly opposite the key, snooted or barred so it hits hair and maybe the top of the shoulders only. Hardness is usually harder than the key so strands sparkle.
Color is often a bit warmer than the face, or matching the key. Keep it out of the eyes.
Prompt: A small lamp behind and above [Subject], lighting only the top of the hair as a rim. The face stays in cooler shadow.
when: Use it when dark hair would vanish into a dark wall, for example a brunette in a black interior. Do not use it as a ceiling wash that skims the forehead and noses.
vs: Backlight can include hair but also shoulders and veil. Rim light runs the whole outline.
Kicker kisses jaw, not the crown. Three-point lighting often uses a hair light as its back point.
Glam may include a hair edge, but glam is a frontal beauty package.
examples_film: Studio portraiture and classical close-ups, including blonde and brunette work in Gentlemen Prefer Blondes and the constructed hair edges in Vertigo, keep a small rear-top unit on the hair. The face still belongs to the key.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a full backlight or a halo. The tell is a glowing oval around the head, or forehead shine from above.
Fix it by snooting the unit onto hair only and keeping the face on the key.

faq.q: What is a hair light in film?
faq.a: A small lamp behind and above the subject that lights hair texture as a rim. It separates dark hair from a dark background without relighting the face.
A hair light is a restricted backlight aimed at the crown. Backlight may wrap the whole rear edge, including shoulders and atmosphere.

faq.q: When should I use a hair light?
faq.a: Use it when black or dark hair would merge with the set. Skip it on hats, bald heads you want matte, or when a full rear rim is the point.

faq.q: How do I prompt a hair light for AI image or video?
faq.a: Place a small lamp behind and above, lighting only the top of the hair. Keep the face in the key or in cooler shadow.
